in_sanskrit.name: Arjansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Brave and Victorious
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Arjansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Arjansh is derived from the Sanskrit language, where 'arj' means 'brave' and 'ansh' means 'descendant'. This name is associated with the great warrior Arjuna from the Mahabharata. It symbolizes the courage and victorious spirit of the warrior class in Hindu tradition.
